program: Arts Technology And The Business Of Innovation BS

constraints.source_text: The degree requires a total of at least 128 units, including 52 units in the core and 36 units in major electives.
constraints.description: The degree requires 52 units of core coursework and 36 units of major electives out of at least 128 total units.
constraints.note: Total degree unit count with two named subcategories; no clean single family fits the overall total, best represented as category bounds.

constraints.source_text: ACAD 174 Innovators Forum Units: 2 (needs to be taken twice); ACAD 376 Industry Practicum I: Designing and Implementing Real-World Solutions Units: 4 or credit bearing industry internship(s); ACAD 475a The Garage Experience Units: 4; ACAD 475b The Garage Experience Units: 4
constraints.description: Students must complete ACAD 174 (twice), ACAD 376 (or a credit-bearing industry internship), ACAD 475a, and ACAD 475b as part of the 16-unit Challenge Based Reflective Learning requirement.

details.scope: Challenge Based Reflective Learning Required Courses (16 Units)

constraints.source_text: Take 8 units from the following: ACAD 183 Product Management for Challenge-Based Innovation Units: 4; ACAD 184 Operations Management and Finance for Challenge-Based Innova Units: 4 or ACAD 185 Analytics and Marketing for Challenge-Based Innovation Units: 4

from: Physical and Embedded Computing for Enhanced Human Performance

unclassified.source_text: Students must select elective courses from the Academy’s offerings in cross-cutting industry areas such as extended reality, product innovation, interactive and physical computing, transformative AI, business of innovation, design strategy and health innovation.
unclassified.why: This is a general descriptive restatement of the Major Electives requirement (already captured in ATBI-06) rather than a distinct new constraint.

unclassified.source_text: In consultation with their academic adviser, students may also petition to create unique degree paths by selecting courses from academic units or disciplines outside of the Academy.
unclassified.why: This describes a discretionary, adviser-approved petition process without a defined course pool or count, and is optional rather than a binding requirement.
